messages:
elaine: Quick async sync on private deploy packaging. Need to lock installer profiles, upgrade lanes, and netops handoff before next field workshop.
jasper: Short bullets please 1 decisions.
maria: Field wants two profiles: 'slim' (no relay, customer egress) and 'ops' (relay + support hooks). Also an allowlist snippet for NetOps.
frank: Upgrade ask: minor in-place rolling upgrades; majors = explicit migration. KV cache compatibility only minor->minor.
jasper: Plan: CLI-first installer for alpha, preflight checks that block on failed egress/DNS/TLS.
netops: We'll produce a one-pager: required egress endpoints, TLS tests, port 443 check. Security review required for allowlist wording.
elaine: Roadmap: Q3 alpha = slim+ops profiles, preflight, allowlist doc; Q4 = minor canary + auto-revert; Q1 = major runbook.
maria: Pilots prefer CLI-first. Will recruit three customers.
frank: I'll prototype revert token and runbook snippets.
deploy-bot: Jira RDW-PRIV-900 created for "slim/ops profiles + preflight".
elaine: Action items: jasper templates+preflight (1w); frank runbook+revert (2w); maria pilots (2w); netops checklist (1w). Flag blockers here.
